behavior: Given an empty cache root and egress blackholed (connections never complete, never error), resolveInstall() always settles -- resolves or rejects -- inside its configured deadline; it never remains pending past that deadline.
rationale: This is a single deterministic fault scenario (no cache, unreachable network) with a binary observable outcome -- settles by the deadline or hangs past it -- which a fixed example scenario asserting completion before the deadline directly falsifies against an implementation that awaits the network with no bound, mirroring how INV-POOL-3 and INV-READY-3 verify their own deadline settlement [INV-PROV-4].
